title: Lane–Emden with a shift
plain: Replace u² in the five-dimensional Lane–Emden equation by the square of u at a shifted point. Are there still no positive solutions?
math: Let $e\in\mathbb R^5$, $e\ne0$. Decide whether there is a positive $u\in C^2(\mathbb R^5)$ with $-\Delta u(x)=u(x+e)^2$ for all $x$.
